description: Configure StackGuide for your project. Auto-detects project type or lets you specify one manually.

conventions.description: Wizard: team conventions as short sentences

enableAdaptiveTdd.description: Enable the adaptive TDD setup wizard that asks for model and integration preferences

integrations.description: External MCP integrations to scaffold as templates

jiraIssueType.description: Default Jira issue type (Task, Story, Bug...)

jiraProjectKey.description: Default Jira project key used when creating tickets from descriptions

mcpSyncTargets.description: Where MCP template servers should be synchronized

model.description: Preferred model identifier for TDD runs (saved in .stackguide/config.json)

models.description: Wizard: model per role, asked as the last wizard question (pass {} to accept defaults), saved for the current IDE only. Defaults: Claude Code opus/haiku/haiku; Cursor inherit (your selected model)/fast/fast; others inherit. Accepts inherit, fast, or any model id your IDE lists

ruleCategories.description: Wizard: only load rules from these categories (saves tokens)

tokenMode.description: Token profile for prompts and workflow responses

type.description: Project type to use (auto-detected if not specified)

wizard.description: Project wizard: asks stack, architecture, methodology, conventions and tracker, then writes the shared stackguide.config.json

name: setup
